-----Original Message-----
From: PNA Shipbrokers - Singapore <pna@pnaship.com> 
Sent: Wednesday, 6 May 2026 08:07
To: pna@pnaship.com
Subject: GBC TCT Requirements



FROM: PACIFIC & ATLANTIC SHIPBROKERS - SINGAPORE / (Email/Teams:
pna@pnaship.com)

**


Pls ppose rated tng for :-

- a/c gbc
- 32000 dwt upto 60000 dwt supramax
- del bohai bay, china
- 15th may / onwards
- 1 tct with bulk cargo intn hbi
- redel indo
- 3.75%add pus 

++++++

- a/c gbc
- about 52000/67000 dwt 
- del fujairah, uae
- 15th may / onwards
- 1tct with aggregates
- redel bangladesh
- 3.75%add pus 

++++++ 

- a/c gbc
- about 52000/67000 dwt
- del w.africa
- earliy june (try vsl dates)
- 1tct with mang ore
- redel eci/china range
- 3.75%add pus 

end >>

B Rgds 
Tony (TEAMS: pna@pnaship.com)





--

missing_info: This email contains THREE separate TCT (Time Charter Trip) requirements, not voyage cargo inquiries. TCT Guard applied.
Inquiry 1: A/C GBC, 32,000–60,000 DWT Supramax, delivery Bohai Bay China, 15 May onwards, 1 TCT with bulk cargo / HBI intention, redelivery Indonesia, 3.75% address commission.
Inquiry 2: A/C GBC, ~52,000–67,000 DWT, delivery Fujairah UAE, 15 May onwards, 1 TCT with aggregates, redelivery Bangladesh, 3.75% address commission.
Inquiry 3: A/C GBC, ~52,000–67,000 DWT, delivery West Africa, early June (vessel dates TBC), 1 TCT with manganese ore, redelivery East Coast India / China range, 3.75% address commission.
All three are period/trip charter requests requiring vessel position offers (tonnage offers), not freight quotations. Please route to chartering desk.
